events.title: Haunted Harbor
events.desc: Witches and warlocks will be paddling through the marina on Friday night, but that’s not the only reason to visit the Everett waterfront. Trick-or-treat along the dock, pick a free pumpkin from the patch, make arts and crafts, and hunt for a hidden octopus to win a handmade glass float!

events.title: Fall Lantern Festival
events.desc: Decorated lanterns light up the park for this creative community celebration. Make art, play games and enjoy live music. There will be free food and cider, tarot card readings, and a photo booth!

events.title: Disney on Ice: ‘Jump In!’
events.loc: Accesso ShoWare Center , 625 W. James St., Kent
events.desc: My daughter’s favorite movies are (big surprise) all Disney, and she is a fan of nearly every character. Many of them will be skating across the rink this weekend during these special performances. Watch Rapunzel and Flynn Rider spin through the air, cheer on Maui and Moana as they cross the ocean, and wave to Mickey and friends! Add on a Magic Pass for an exclusive character greeting and premi…

events.title: Giant Skulls Day of the Dead Art Exhibit
events.desc: Explore a new colorful exhibition that’s taken over Westlake Park in celebration of Día de los Muertos. The giant skulls are beautifully decorated and worth a visit. (Psst … if you’re downtown on Friday evening, head to Pike Place Market for more Día de los Muertos festivities , including a parade!)

events.title: Kitsap Live Steamers Ghost Train
events.loc: South Kitsap Regional Park , 3100 S.E. Marbeth Ln., Port Orchard
events.desc: Ready for a spooky train ride through the forest? Hop aboard the Kitsap Steamers mini train. Wear those costumes, because there will be trick-or-treat booths too! Tickets support the Western Washington Center for the Arts.

events.title: Issaquah Zombie Walk
events.loc: Historic Shell Station and Downtown Issaquah , 232 Front St. N., Issaquah
events.desc: My daughter has been practicing her zombie walk ahead of Halloween, and this is the place to show it off! Come early for a zombie makeover and join the undead as they crawl through downtown, or just watch as they take over! Create your own canvas trick-or-treat bag, play carnival games, snap selfies and enter to win a gift basket of goodies.

events.title: Pythagorean Palooza
events.loc: SUMM at Kent Station , 437 Ramsay Way, Suite 102, Kent
events.desc: If helping your kids with their homework has started to feel a little challenging, this is the spot to make learning about math more fun! First, you’ll need to brush up on the Pythagorean theorem, because Saturday’s date is a Pythagorean triple. That won’t happen again this century, and the Seattle Universal Math Museum is making the most of it. Explore triangle-themed exhibits, solve puzzles a…

events.title: Salmon Discovery Walk and Scavenger Hunt
events.loc: Sammamish River Trail , 15670 N.E. 85th St., Redmond
events.desc: It’s not too late to spot salmon ! Walk along the Sammamish River Trail, learn about the salmon life cycle and spot a few triumphant fish. The trail is flat and accessible, and a scavenger hunt (with prizes!) adds to the fun.

events.title: The Museum of Fright
events.cost: Included with admission; kids in costume are free
events.loc: The Museum of Flight , 9404 East Marginal Way S., Seattle
events.desc: Live music from the 8-Bit Brass Band will fill the Museum of Flight this weekend as it transforms into The Museum of Fright ! You can expect a mad science show, face painting, Halloween-themed games, and arts and crafts. Wear your costumes!

events.title: Shorts4Shorties at The Tacoma Film Festival
events.loc: The Grand Cinema , 606 Fawcett Ave., Tacoma
events.desc: If the gloomy fall weather really kicks in this weekend, it’s the perfect time to head to the movies. The Tacoma Film Festival features a special screening of family-friendly shorts on Sunday morning, and it all starts with a complimentary breakfast cereal bar in the lounge. And yes — you can wear your pajamas.
